meta.name: python-appservice-deploy
meta.description: Deploy Python (Flask/Django/FastAPI) code to Azure App Service Linux. WHEN: "Flask App Service", "Django App Service", "FastAPI App Service", "deploy Python to App Service". DO NOT USE FOR: Container Apps, Functions, non-Python, Terraform/Bicep/IaC, full infra — use azure-prepare.

howto.what: 把 Python(Flask/Django/FastAPI)代码部署到 Azure App Service Linux。缺少资源组、计划、Web App 时会自动创建,检测框架并设置启动命令,部署完成后打印结果并结束。
howto.when: 当你提到“Flask App Service”“Django App Service”等,或要求把 Python 部署到 App Service 时接管;不用于 Container Apps、Functions 或非 Python 项目。

howto.what_en: Deploys Python (Flask/Django/FastAPI) code to Azure App Service Linux. Creates the resource group, plan and web app if missing, detects the framework and sets the startup command, then prints a post-deploy message and stops.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention "Flask App Service", "Django App Service" etc., or ask to deploy Python to App Service. Not for Container Apps, Functions or non-Python projects.
